description: A reflected cross-site scripting finding: payload injected into a query parameter, observed by seeing the payload reflected in the response. Differs from dast-01 in every discriminating field, including both the injection point and the evidence signal.

mutations.name: http_method_lowercased
mutations.description: Method case does not fork identity.

mutations.name: route_template_carrying_the_injected_query_parameter
mutations.description: The query string is dropped: injection_point and param_name already record which query parameter was targeted, so keeping it would hash the payload value as well.

notes: Paired with dast-01 to demonstrate that two DAST findings on one target stay distinct. Sharing a target_id with dast-01 and dast-03 is deliberate: the target is not what separates them.
Route templates are case-sensitive and are NOT folded: URL paths are case-sensitive, and '/Search' is a different route from '/search' on most servers.
